title: Granularity contribution value
description: Value type for contributions on the Granularity panel. Each contribution proposes a consolidation decision for the referenced SubjectIdentity, considering peers within the same enclosing Structure. Axis-2 profile (Standard | Coarse | Fine | BoundaryOnly) biases which GranularityKSs are eligible to fire.

targetIdentityKeys.description: For splitInto: identity keys of the target SubjectIdentities to create. For mergeWith: identity keys of the SubjectIdentities to merge into. Empty for keep / drop.
